verdict.rationale: Cline documents a dedicated CLI with headless mode explicitly for scripts/automation and CI/CD, autonomous execution without prompts, and explicit statements about running headlessly inside GitHub Actions/GitLab/any pipeline, plus cron-based scheduling that persists across restarts. This is first-party documentation with no independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage specifically. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of actual CI pipeline runs, and any published CI templates/examples.
